name: Claude Dev

commands.name: sessions
commands.description: One line per session: working or idle, commits, port, PR

goal: A lead for parallel Claude Code sessions on one of your repositories, on your own computer with your Claude subscription. Start a session from its page and it becomes its own worker with its own git worktree, branch and app ports; ask the lead what's going on across all of them, or have it hand work out.
